author: a. w. anderson
title: Jack Ricciardi named to inaugural Coach Liam Gleason Humanitarian Award class
text:
University of Richmond senior attackman Jack Ricciardi has been named to the inaugural class for the Coach Liam Gleason Humanitarian Award, announced Wednesday, May 20.
The award was established in January by family, friends, and former coaches of Siena lacrosse coach Liam Gleason, who passed away in December 2025. It recognizes individuals who demonstrate leadership, strong support for teammates and staff, sportsmanship, and community involvement.
Each NCAA Division I men’s lacrosse program selected one student-athlete from its team to receive the award at the end of the 2026 season. The recipient was chosen through a vote by players, coaches, and staff as the individual on each roster whom teammates most aspire to emulate.
Ricciardi began his career at Richmond as a scout team player and later filled a key left-handed attack position during his junior year. He made his first career start in a win over Georgetown on March 22, 2025. Following that game, he started every match for Richmond. In his first start he scored three goals and continued with a breakout senior season—scoring points in 15 out of 16 games for a total of 34 points (21 goals and 13 assists).
The creation of this award highlights efforts within collegiate athletics to honor not only athletic performance but also leadership qualities and contributions beyond competition.
